verdict.rationale: BILL provides several autonomous background automations (Invoice Coding Agent for automatic bill coding, vendor autopay triggered by bill creation, automatic vendor matching, real-time webhook event notifications that can drive downstream automations) which support background, event-driven processing. However there is no evidence of a dedicated automation/workflow builder for AI-native users to configure custom autonomous background tasks beyond these fixed features. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation/agent builder UI, documentation of persistent scheduled/triggered custom automations, and independent corroboration of autonomous execution reliability.
